addr: 21, 3rd Main Rd, behind Good Food Super Market, Vyalikaval, Kodandarampura, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: Amazing place to record mix master and get a brilliant output and a good place to record instruments.

The studio is cool and they do have good facility. But the fact that Mr. Prajwal is busy and does not respond to calls and messages and fails to get the work on time delays the concept unacceptably. One can give a try at this studio but need to be aware that time bound assignments can suffer due to their lack of efficiency.

Recently we have visited this studio for dubbing for our short film...  Studio is very impressive and one of the best studios with good space and acoustics... Polite and dedicated staff made our long work easy and pleasant...thank you guys...
